articles.title: Ipsen (ENXTPA:IPN) Posts Strong IQIRVO Data, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
articles.summary: Ipsen (ENXTPA:IPN) moved into focus after late breaking ELSPIRE Phase III data showed that IQIRVO achieved ALP normalization in 85.3% of primary biliary cholangitis patients, compared with 23.3% for placebo at Week 52. Set against that clinical update, Ipsen’s share price has climbed 11.21% over the past month and 36.69% year to date, while total shareholder return is 29.55% over one year and 86.14% across five years, which points to momentum that has been building rather than fading. articles.title: Charles River Laboratories (CRL) Expands Virtual Control Group Use In Toxicology Studies
articles.summary: Charles River Laboratories International (NYSE:CRL) agreed to deploy its Virtual Control Group database for Ipsen to support toxicology studies and reduce animal use. The Ipsen collaboration uses AI powered analytics and historical control data to replace some live control groups in preclinical testing. articles.title: Ipsen (ENXTPA:IPN) Could Be 11% Undervalued Following Board Changes
articles.summary: Ipsen (ENXTPA:IPN) has refreshed its governance, with the board appointing Mariette Finet as Director and member of the Board Portfolio Committee following Michèle Ollier’s resignation earlier in the summer. Ipsen’s share price has softened in the short term, with a 1-month share price return down 10.18% and a 7-day move lower by 4.30%.
